import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "value": [10.5, 20.3, 15.8, 25.1, 30.9]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory (bytes buffer)
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the bytes
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nParquet size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from the bytes buffer
buffer.seek(0)  # Reset buffer position to the beginning
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify they are equal
print("\nDataFrames equal:", df.equals(df_restored))

import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "value": [10.5, 20.3, 15.8, 25.1, 30.9]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory (bytes buffer)
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the bytes
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nParquet size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from the bytes buffer
buffer.seek(0)  # Reset buffer position to the beginning
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify they are equal
print("\nDataFrames equal:", df.equals(df_restored))
